title.zh: Revised CLARITY Act targets ‘non-decentralized’ DeFi operators
title.en: Revised CLARITY Act targets ‘non-decentralized’ DeFi operators

current_state.zh: A revised CLARITY Act would require US regulators to determine whether operators of 'non-decentralized finance trading protocols' must register and comply with securities, commodities, and AML requirements.
current_state.en: A revised CLARITY Act would require US regulators to determine whether operators of 'non-decentralized finance trading protocols' must register and comply with securities, commodities, and AML requirements.
